generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A re-audit package can preserve visible findings while dropping a stable identity edge needed to associate an independent rejection with its closure unless the producer and consumer cross-check that identity explicitly.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Copy the audit head and finding labels into the result package, omit the stable rejection identifier, and treat matching text or SHA as sufficient proof of closure.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: A producer must carry every stable independent-rejection identifier verbatim through the learning event and matching escape closure before freeze or publication.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: A consumer must cross-check the stable independent-rejection identifier and all declared finding identifiers between the learning event and passed escape closures before broad auditing.

transfer_cases.procedure: Omit the stable rejection identifier while preserving the audit head and finding label; require deterministic rejection.
Keep the learning identifier but remove or alter it in the matching escape source; require deterministic rejection.
Publish an internally consistent result child whose identity edge is missing; require terminal semantic rejection.

skill_changes.change: Independent rejection closure requires verbatim rejection identity in learning and escape ledgers before freeze and handoff.
Re-audit preflight cross-checks stable rejection identity and finding coverage before broad audit.
